content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-3|creator]]s in regions where conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable face significant infrastructure challenges. With COREMERCH, you can deploy a fully operational digital store using Cloudflare Pages, without relying on those platforms. This guide will walk you through the steps needed to set up your store effectively, ensuring you can accept crypto payments seamlessly and without restrictions. It’s time to reclaim your sovereignty in digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment processors often restrict access to creators in various regions, leaving them with limited [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments|COREMERCH guide to options]]-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-6|The Top]]. This is where COREMERCH's infrastructure excels. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments, you bypass the reliance on platforms that can lock you out. This setup grants you complete ownership and control over your digital store, ensuring that you are never at the mercy of external payment systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you embark on deploying your digital store, ensure you have the essential components in place. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting your site, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Your product files should be ready for upload, and you should have a clear strategy for your marketing. Familiarity with GitHub or similar platforms will ease the deployment process. This preparation sets the stage for a smooth launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

This step involves connecting your payment processing to your product delivery system. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies. Follow the integration guides provided by NOWPayments to ensure seamless transactions. Next, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, making sure that your products are easily accessible to customers upon successful payment. Testing this pipeline before going live is crucial to avoid any issues during transactions.
Own your digital store without relying on traditional payment processors.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set, it’s time to launch your store. Publish your site on Cloudflare Pages and conduct a final review of all configurations. After ensuring everything is functioning correctly, promote your store to your audience. When a customer makes their first purchase, the NOWPayments webhook will trigger, confirming payment immediately. This real-time processing allows you to deliver products instantly, enhancing customer satisfaction and trust.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor transaction volumes and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement. You can expand your product offerings by loading additional items into the system, utilizing the flexibility of your infrastructure. Consider implementing marketing strategies to attract more customers. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can scale effectively while maintaining full control over your infrastructure.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to retain ownership of your store without relying on traditional payment processors. You will be in control of your digital commerce without any ongoing costs.
Seamless crypto payments allow you to bypass currency restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're considering advanced infrastructure, explore the Edge Commerce Stack for a comprehensive setup in just 48 hours. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, ensuring a robust and scalable digital store. For more insights on building your store, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 leverages GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing for deployment in 4-6 hours. Stack 02, which utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours and includes end-to-end testing, ensuring a more robust setup.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. These platforms provide a reliable infrastructure for deploying your store without relying on conventional payment processors.
What is NOWPayments and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a crypto payment gateway that allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. It verifies payments on-chain with a low fee of 0.5% and requires no KYC, making it ideal for digital creators looking for seamless transactions.
What support is included after deploying my digital store?

After deploying your digital store, COREMERCH offers a 30-day support window. This ensures that you have assistance with any technical issues or questions you may encounter as you start processing transactions.
